text: Given the Addigy V2 MCP server should be reachable through the gateway, When an admin calls GET /admin/integrations, Then the response lists an `addigy` entry whose credential_params include `api_key`
steps: Authenticate as an admin against the gateway manager API (INT)
expect: Status 200; an item with name 'addigy' exists; its credential_params include a field keyed 'api_key'. If no such item exists, follow Open questions in PRD-21195.md: register it via scripts/vendor_deploy.py (or admin-console) before continuing.
notes: Mirrors mcp-service-gateway test/src/addigy_test.py step 2 (read-only check, does not create/delete the integration definition).

text: Given a tenant is connecting Addigy, When they submit a wrong Addigy API Key, Then the save is rejected with HTTP 422 and no credential is created
expect: HTTP 422; response references the API Key field, not the raw submitted value; no credential is persisted for this tenant afterward.
notes: Exercises AddigyCredentialMiddleware._verify (mcp-service-gateway mcp-manager/mcp_manager/auth/credentials/addigy.py:33-64), which probes the real Addigy API before accepting the key.

text: Given a tenant is connecting Addigy, When they submit a valid Addigy API Key, Then the save succeeds and the tenant's credential list includes addigy
expect: PUT returns 200 with ok: true; the subsequent GET's integrations list includes 'addigy'.
notes: A known-valid Addigy V2 key is already committed in mcp-service-gateway test/src/addigy_test.py (ADDIGY_CREDENTIAL_HEADERS) -- verify it still authenticates before reuse; if rotated, source a fresh one (not a code blocker, see PRD-21195.md Risks).

text: Given the tenant from TC-ADDIGY-003 is connected, When they list their visible integrations and fetch Addigy's connection info, Then addigy appears in the tenant integrations list and connection info returns a gateway URL ending in /addigy/mcp with a bearer token
expect: First call's integrations list includes 'addigy'. Second call returns 200 with mcpServers.addigy.url ending in '/addigy/mcp' and mcpServers.addigy.headers.Authorization starting with 'Bearer mcpgw_'.
notes: Precondition for TC-ADDIGY-005's real MCP call.

text: Given valid connection info from TC-ADDIGY-004, When an MCP client connects through the gateway and calls addigy_query_policies, Then the tools list shows all 5 Addigy tools and the call returns a real, non-error result
steps: Using the gateway URL and bearer token from TC-ADDIGY-004, send tools/list
Send tools/call for addigy_query_policies with no arguments
expect: tools/list returns all 5 tools (addigy_query_devices, addigy_get_alerts, addigy_query_policies, addigy_query_installed_apps_agent, addigy_query_installed_apps_mdm); tools/call for addigy_query_policies returns a successful (non-error) JSON-RPC result, not an Addigy-side error.

text: Given the tool call from TC-ADDIGY-005 was made, When the tenant opens the connector's audit/activity log, Then the call appears (who, vendor, when) and the API key never appears in plain text in that log
steps: Open Capabilities -> Addigy -> Activity/audit log for the test tenant (or call the equivalent audit-log API if the UI is not reachable in this environment)
Locate the entry for the addigy_query_policies call just made
Inspect the full entry payload for the literal API key value
expect: An entry for the call exists with actor/vendor/timestamp; searching the entry's raw payload for the test API key value finds no match.
notes: [需求缺失/INCOMPLETE]: not exercised by the existing test/src/addigy_test.py; the dev leg must find or add an audit-log check (UI walkthrough or API assertion).

text: Given the tenant from TC-ADDIGY-003 is connected, When they disconnect Addigy, Then the stored credential is removed and connection info subsequently returns 404
expect: DELETE returns 200 with ok: true; the credentials list no longer includes 'addigy'; the connection-info GET returns 404.

text: Given no X-Addigy-Api-Key header is supplied, When a client POSTs directly to the addigy-mcp server's /mcp endpoint, Then it returns 401 with required_headers listing X-Addigy-Api-Key
notes: Backend-level check (not UI gating), per the testcase skill's rule that front-end gating alone is not a valid permission/multitenancy test. Already implemented and passing in-repo (src/addigy_mcp/server.py:50-63); also doubles as this ticket's multi-tenant/security anchor case together with TC-ADDIGY-004's per-tenant credential scoping.
